title: SugarCaneHarvester
description: A light weight mod that helps you with harvesting Sugarcanes. Client Sided.
body:
# SCH - Sugar Cane Harvester!

- This light weight mod will help you harvest (for now) Sugar Canes., 
A helpful mod that helps you if you have physical or device imparities issues!

Client Sided, Works on Server! But ask permissions first to the staffs to prevent unintentional ban.

## Features.
With a Press of H (you can change it on keybinds)
- Will Turn players perspective to the nearest (5 radius) sugarcane
- Will Automatically harvest sugarcane and leave sugarcane stem.
- Will send feed back to the current status of the mod (toggleable)
- Randomness to sugarcane aim lock to prevent anti cheats. Though it's not
- Changeable config to the desired set-up through commands

##   Commands

- /caneharvester - Base Command
  
- /caneharvester speed <value>
  Adjusts how fast the player rotates toward sugarcane (0.5–10 degrees per tick).
- /caneharvester smoothness <value>
  Adjusts how smoothly the rotation approaches the target (0.1–1).
- /caneharvester delay <min> <max>
  Sets minimum and maximum delay (in milliseconds) between harvest swings.
  Randomized between min and max for human-like timing.
- /caneharvester jitter on/off
  Adds small random variations to yaw (a.k.a shaking hands~~~~) and pitch to simulate a human player.
- /caneharvester feedback on/off
  you know what this does.

### Important!!
- This is made purely with intention to help people like me who have Physical and Device imparities.
